subject: F6: QEMU plugin drains L2C control via hwaddr
description: qemu_plugin/hybrid_handoff.c: read L2C control word via qemu_plugin_read_memory_hwaddr(l2c_base+0x8,buf,4); set HYBRID_FLAG_L2C; add l2c_base plugin arg (default 0xE0500000). Plugin smoke test: ELF sw's known value to 0xE0500008, assert drained field.
